allowed_dependency_manifest.content: Fix an integer n greater than 1. Define f(x) = floor of n times x minus the sum from k = 1 to n of (floor of k times x) divided by k. Determine the set of real numbers x for which f(x) is a global maximum among all real y, and determine the value of that global maximum.

forbidden_claims.statement_nl: Let $n$ be an integer greater than 1. For which real numbers $x$ is \\[\\lfloor nx \\rfloor - \\sum_{k=1}^{n} \\frac{\\lfloor kx \\rfloor}{k}\\] maximal, and what is the maximal value that this expression can take?

statement_nl: Let n > 1, define H_n = sum_{k=1}^n 1/k, and let f_n be defined by f_n(x) = floor(n*x) - sum_{k=1}^n floor(k*x)/k. For every integer m with 0 <= m <= n-2, one has f_n(m/n) < H_n - 1.
